name: toggle holdings, Inc.
summary: toggle holdings, Inc. designs, develops, and operates AI-based software platforms, digital infrastructure solutions, and real estate technology (PropTech) services in Japan. The company, through its platform, automates real estate information collection and analysis, architectural planning, land assessment, investment evaluation, and business workflow optimization.
